title: Accrual End for Daily Late Fees under a Late Fee Review — Apartment Home Lease Collections Standard
content:
Under a late fee review of an Apartment Home Lease, the accrual end moves: when a payment plan request drawn up on or after the period's due date is awaiting the resident's signature (request status submitted), the accrual end is the date that request was drawn up; when no such request is awaiting signature and a delinquency notice was served for the period, the accrual end is the notice date; otherwise the accrual end stays the handling date.

## Order of the tests

| A payment plan request awaiting signature, drawn up on or after the period's due date | A delinquency notice served for the period | Accrual end |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | the date the request was drawn up |
| No | Yes | the notice date |
| No | No | the handling date |

**Records read.** The payment plan requests of the lease that are awaiting the resident's signature — the most recently drawn-up of them, with the date it was drawn up — and the delinquency notices served for the reviewed billing period, with their notice date (the latest when there is more than one). A request that has been signed, completed or defaulted is not awaiting signature. A request awaiting signature that was drawn up before the period's due date does not set the accrual end.

**What the accrual end governs.** Daily late fee lines are allowed through the accrual end.

## Cases (hypothetical, period due 1 May, first late day of the review 5 May)

| Records | Accrual end | Daily lines allowed (days after 5 May through the accrual end) |
|---|---|---|
| Request awaiting signature drawn up 9 May; notice served 7 May | 9 May | 4 |
| No request awaiting signature; notice served 7 May | 7 May | 2 |
| Neither; handling date 14 May | 14 May | 9 |
| Request awaiting signature drawn up 28 April (before the due date); no notice; handling date 14 May | 14 May | 9 |
